messages:
maria: FYI GHAS + Trivy job is flapping on the scanner pipeline. Seen a bunch of failures in the reconciliation step for suppression rules, and it's failing the whole job (exit code 2).
jamal: Ugh. Any logs? Which stage exactly?
maria: pastebin://logs/ghas-trivy-1789876543 -> primary error: "suppression-reconciler: mismatch on rule_id 4321, invalid matcher"
sec-bot: [scanner-bot] pipeline 3421: trivy-scan failed (code 2) -> https://ci.internal/pipelines/3421
alek: That matcher mismatch sounds like a schema drift between our suppression DB and the new GHAS import format. We changed the regex field to "pattern" in last week's deploy. Could be migrating rule sets from Snyk/Trivy import job.
sophie: If suppressions are mis-applied we could be suppressing active CVEs or, conversely, failing too loud. Can we list affected repo(s) and CVE IDs so security team can prioritize patches?
maria: Affected repos: infra/packager, platform/api. Example CVEs in the noisy group: CVE-2024-4512, CVE-2025-0131, CVE-2023-9999 (no exploit known).
jamal: Quick triage: prioritize CVE-2024-4512 (high, public PoC), then 2025-0131 (medium but widespread). Mark 2023-9999 as informational for now.
alek: I can push a hotfix to the reconciler to accept both "regex" and "pattern" keys and wrap parsing with a fallback. Patch in draft: 
```
// pseudo
rule.matcher = rule.pattern || rule.regex || "";
if (!isValidMatcher(rule.matcher)) throw ReconcileError(rule.id)
```
maria: Nice. Also we should avoid auto-applying suppressions during reconcile until we validate rule matches against a sample repo. Can we add a dry-run mode?
leo: Also check RBAC for the suppression-import job — last deploy tightened KMS wrappers and the job may be missing decrypt permissions for the rules blob. If it can't decrypt, it might produce malformed json and trigger the mismatch.
sophie: Good call. Who owns KMS policy check? @leo?
leo: I'll take it. If decrypt fails we'll see an explicit KMS error, but some code paths swallowed the error and returned empty strings. I'll add an assertion and a metric.
jamal: Ops suggestion: short-term rollback to prev reconciler image and re-run pipeline until patch lands. That avoids noisy failures and keeps scanner up.
maria: Rolling back now to image: ghcr.redwood/reconciler:v1.9.2 -> starting rollback job 3423.
sec-bot: [scanner-bot] pipeline 3423: reconcile-rollback started by maria
alek: I'll open a PR for the fallback parser + dry-run flag and request review from jamal and sophie. PR: https://git.internal/repos/reconciler/pulls/128
sophie: Once PR landed, let's run reconciliation in dry-run against infra/packager and confirm suppressed findings match expected. Then we can re-enable auto-apply.
maria: Agreed. I'll watch the rollback and confirm pipeline green. Thanks all :thumbsup:
leo: Adding a follow-up ticket to tighten KMS error handling and add unit tests for malformed suppression blobs -> SECURITY-881
jamal: Great. Closing noisy alert and adding an incident note to postmortems.
sec-bot: [incident-bot] incident SECURITY-381 created: scanner-reconcile-failure (owner: maria)
maria: Adding timeline and links to the incident. I'll update once rollback completes.
